newsitem.title: USA: Atria completes $200 mln revolving credit.
newsitem.headline: Atria completes $200 mln revolving credit.

text.p: Atria Communities Inc said Friday it has closed a $200 million four-year, revolving credit facility.

Additionally, Atria said underwriters for its initial public offering of 5,000,000 shares, which was completed last month, have exercised their over-allotment option for an additional 750,000 shares. The lead underwriter was Morgan Stanley Group Inc, the company said.
Atria said it has realized a total of approximately $53 million in net proceeds from the offering and the exercise of the option.

National City Bank, PNC Bank and Toronto-Dominion Bank are agents for the credit facility, and 12 banks comprise the lending group. The facility is structured with separate funding amounts for mature and development properties.
Atria operates 22 assisted and independent living communities for the elderly.
